data.title: The House Register baseline
data.why_selected: Preserve the human-rejected site as negative evidence
data.notes: Technical functionality may be reused. Human verdict rejects the visual direction; do not infer specific disliked properties beyond recorded feedback.

data.reason: The rendered website was perceived as generic, visibly AI-generated, aesthetically weak, and below professionally art-directed commercial work.
data.limits: No more granular owner preference was supplied; do not attribute specific typography, color, or layout objections to the owner.

data.principle: Do not certify a KAMEN visual direction through AI-only preference or drift ratings.
data.observation: The prior AI review loop approved the rendered baseline, which the human owner rejected immediately.
data.do_not_copy: The rejected House Register grammar is historical evidence, not a new template.
